rationale: Notifications disabled so worker only polls: cancel_job (documented to need notifications to interrupt running jobs) races with fetch pending->running and running->succeeded. 1-job cancel cases isolate cancel-vs-completion lost-update / overwritten state. 2-job FF is control for fetch order/duplicates. TF vs FT varies which ref is cancelled first in list order while fetch order is UUID-nondeterministic, exposing cancel-pending vs cancel-running. max_attempts 1 vs 2 checks if a cancelled attempt is counted and retried/re-executed. n=0 checks falsy 0 result handling.
